findings_and_resolutions.finding: Replay had no own 120-second whole-process bound.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: The formal launcher applies a 120-second outer deadline to replay.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Targeted SIGINT/SIGTERM or child post-identity failures could bypass complete cleanup/reporting.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Launcher owns signal/timeout handling, records cleanup errors, uses retained PID/start-time/pidfd cleanup, preserves child streams/exit code, and rejects missing or non-passing child report/manifest.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Replay critical HEAD/seal/output guards used assert, removable under optimization.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Guards use explicit require; launcher removes PYTHONOPTIMIZE.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Actual GCC calls were absent from targeted tool identity coverage.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: GCC is included in before/after tool identity and controlled PATH resolution. Static resolution observed /usr/bin/gcc -> /usr/bin/x86_64-linux-gnu-gcc-13, without running GCC.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Replay per-case progress and baseline after-check needed explicit records.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Each case records START/completion; baseline members are hashed before and after; output is rejected inside source or old baseline.
